name: B10-0406/2026 – § 5 – Am 64
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 5.Calls for coordination and shared responsibility between regional, state and EU administrations to be strengthened, providing Ceuta with sufficient resources and rapid response mechanisms to return to normality, including adequate economic support for affected businesses, workers and residents;
